constraint_enforcement_truth.mechanism_detail: OpenAI-compatible response_format {type: json_schema, json_schema: {name, schema, strict: true}} on Ollama 0.23.1
constraint_enforcement_truth.truth_note: Compiled recovery constraint schema bound as native grammar via json_schema response_format. Ollama 0.23.1 enforces schema constraints at generation time — const values, required fields, and additionalProperties: false are all respected. No GBNF/grammar-level enforcement available. This IS native schema enforcement, not mere prompted formatting.
constraint_enforcement_truth.verification_proof: Schema with const values forced model to emit exact const strings across 3 independent runs — impossible without grammar-level schema enforcement.

d2_initial_audit_correction.correction: Original D2 audit overstated closure. json_object transport formatting was exercised but native constraint enforcement was NOT proven. This superseding audit records json_schema enforcement as genuinely exercised.
